Summary: The HotpotQA dataset contains 7,405 examples each in the dev and test-distractor subsets, and 7,405 examples in the test-fullwiki subset, all categorized as hard multi-hop questions. These subsets are derived from the hard examples, which focus on questions that current modeling techniques struggle to answer. The total number of examples in the dataset is 112,779, split into train-easy, train-medium, train-hard, dev, test-distractor, and test-fullwiki subsets.
